name: weave
title_zh: 给一个话题，自动侦察并产出有据可查的中文长文
tagline_zh: 丢一个词就自动侦察来源，深读散文、重构技术系统、六阶段写作，每句都有出处。适合写综述、技术解析、开放域深度报道。
tagline_en: Drop a topic, it scouts sources, deep-reads prose, reconstructs tech systems, and writes in six phases—every.
desc_en: Multi-source research pipeline that produces evidence-grounded Chinese longform from a source bundle, technical project, or open domain. Deep Read handles prose sources, Source Dive reconstructs technical systems, and Survey uses a Learn-based six-phase research-to-writing workflow with an explicit Spine Direction Gate and sparse Visual Pass. Auto-scouts when the user provides only a topic. Use wh
why_zh: 不是一次性生成，而是带门禁的流水线：方向闸门卡住论点，稀疏视觉防跑偏，证据链贯穿始终。
why_en: Not one-shot generation—a gated pipeline with a spine-direction gate and sparse visual pass to keep claims grounded.
limit_zh: 只产出中文长文；需能联网抓取；对纯虚构或非文本主题（如纯音频）无效；最终稿仍需人工核对事实与引用。
limit_en: Chinese longform only; requires internet access; not for fiction or non-text topics; final fact-check still needed.
title_en: Auto-scout a topic, write evidence-grounded Chinese longform
